mentions.name: AudioWeave
mentions.description: AudioWeave is an ad-free, offline-first Android podcast player focused on privacy, with no tracking or ads. It is built entirely natively using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, and Media3/ExoPlayer, and has been used daily by the author for six months before a public beta release.
mentions.problem: After switching from iOS, the author wasn't happy with existing podcast apps and wanted a nice-looking, privacy-focused player without tracking or ads.
mentions.audience: Built primarily for personal use by the author after switching from iOS and being unhappy with existing podcast apps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
